query_text: how do you type up minutes of a meeting

parts.text:
Typing up meeting minutes can feel overwhelming, but it becomes much easier once you follow a structured process. Meeting minutes are not a word-for-word transcript; instead, they should be a **concise, objective summary of the decisions made, actions agreed upon, and next steps.**

Here is a step-by-step guide on how to write, format, and type up professional meeting minutes, along with a free template you can use.

---

### Step 1: Prepare Before the Meeting
Preparation is the secret to easy note-taking. 
* **Get the agenda:** Use the meeting agenda as your outline. It tells you exactly what topics will be discussed.
* **Create a template:** Have a document ready with the meeting name, date, time, and attendee list already filled out (or ready to be checked off).
* **Clarify expectations:** Ask the meeting chair if there is a specific format they prefer or if there are specific discussions they want highlighted.

---

### Step 2: Take Smart Notes During the Meeting
Do not try to write down every word. Focus on capturing the **substance** of the meeting:
* **Decisions made:** (e.g., *"The budget increase of 10% was approved."*)
* **Action items:** Note down **Who** is doing **What** by **When**. (e.g., *"Jane to submit the final budget report by Friday, Oct 12."*)
* **Key discussions:** Write a brief 1-2 sentence summary of the main points argued for/against a topic, rather than quoting individuals.
* **Record votes (if applicable):** Note who proposed motions, who seconded them, and the outcome of the vote.

---

### Step 3: Type Up the Minutes (The Structure)
Type up your notes as soon as possible after the meeting while your memory is fresh. Write in a **neutral, objective tone** (avoid using emotional language or personal opinions).

Use the following standard structure to type them up:

#### 1. Header Information
* **Name of the organization/group**
* **Type of meeting** (e.g., Monthly Board Meeting, Weekly Marketing Sync)
* **Date, time, and location** (or virtual platform, like Zoom)

#### 2. Attendance
* **Present:** List of names (often alphabetical by last name).
* **Absent/Apologies:** List of members who could not attend but sent their regrets.
* **Guests/Facilitators:** Anyone invited for specific agenda items.

#### 3. Approval of Previous Minutes
* A brief note stating whether the minutes from the last meeting were approved or if any corrections were made.

#### 4. Discussion Items (The Agenda Topics)
For each topic discussed, write:
* **The topic title** (matching the agenda).
* **A brief summary** of the discussion.
* **The outcome/decision** reached.

#### 5. Action Items (The "To-Do" List)
Create a clear, easy-to-read table or bulleted list of tasks. This is the most important part of the minutes.
* **Task:** What needs to be done.
* **Owner:** Who is responsible.
* **Deadline:** When it is due.

#### 6. Next Meeting & Adjournment
* **Next Meeting:** The date, time, and location of the next scheduled meeting.
* **Adjournment:** The exact time the meeting officially ended.
* **Submitted by:** Your name and signature block as the note-taker.

---

### Step 4: Review and Distribute
1. **Proofread:** Check for spelling, grammar, and clarity. Ensure you used the past tense (e.g., *"The committee decided..."* rather than *"The committee decides..."*).
2. **Get approval:** Send the draft to the meeting chair or facilitator for a quick review before sending it to the wider group.
3. **Distribute:** Send the approved minutes to all attendees and anyone who was absent but needs to be kept in the loop. 
4. **Archive:** Save the final document in your company’s shared drive or file system for future reference.

---

### Sample Meeting Minutes Template

> **MINUTES OF THE [COMMITTEE/TEAM NAME] MEETING**
> 
> **Date:** [Date]  
> **Time:** [Start Time] to [End Time]  
> **Location:** [Room Name / Zoom Link]  
> **Meeting Chair:** [Name]  
> **Minute Taker:** [Name]  
> 
> ---
> 
> ### 1. Attendance
> * **Present:** [Name], [Name], [Name]
> * **Apologies:** [Name]
> * **Guests:** [Name]
> 
> ### 2. Approval of Previous Minutes
> * The minutes of the meeting held on [Previous Date] were reviewed and [approved without correction / approved with the following corrections: ...].
> 
> ### 3. Agenda Items & Decisions
> 
> **Item 1: [Topic Name]**
> * **Discussion:** [Brief 2–3 sentence summary of the discussion. Mention key points raised.]
> * **Decision:** [Write down the final decision made.]
> 
> **Item 2: [Topic Name]**
> * **Discussion:** [Summary of discussion.]
> * **Decision:** [Decision made.]
> 
> ---
> 
> ### 4. Action Items (Next Steps)
> | Action Item / Task | Assigned To | Due Date |
> | :--- | :--- | :--- |
> | Draft the Q4 social media plan | [Name] | [Date] |
> | Send budget approval form to HR | [Name] | [Date] |
> 
> ---
> 
> ### 5. Next Meeting
> * **Date:** [Date] at [Time]
> * **Location:** [Location/Link]
> 
> **Meeting Adjourned at:** [End Time]  
> **Submitted by:** [Your Name, Title]
